q: Lyubich's theorem on the density of hyperbolicity in the real quadratic family fᵣ(x) = rx(1−x) states that:
opts: The Mandelbrot set has positive measure
Hyperbolicity is dense in parameter space (for the real family): for almost every r ∈ [0,4], fᵣ has an attracting periodic orbit
Every r ∈ [0,4] gives a hyperbolic map
The chaotic parameters form a set of positive measure
exp: Lyubich (1997): hyperbolic parameters are dense in [0,4] for the real logistic family. Moreover, the set of non-hyperbolic parameters has measure zero (Lyubich, following Graczyk-Swiatek). This is a major result toward the 'density of hyperbolicity' conjecture in the complex setting (still open).
